notes: Dynamic action buttons for permissions explicitly granted by AD. Example: a Ca Pho granted DAILY_ROSTER gets a direct DAILY ROSTER chip without changing role. Direct extra-action chips currently cover DAILY ROSTER, A/C LIMITS, FLEET, FSAGS 09, FSAGS 208 and FINAL; contextual rights stay inside the relevant form. Revoking the permission removes the chip after permission sync. Retains all V3.25 behavior.
